_note: Agent World roster. Add an agent here and it walks into the world: no code change needed (fixes audit F9). acc = accessory id from agents.js ACCESSORIES. home = zone id or show:<stage id>.

agents.name: Conscious Claude
agents.title: Chief of Staff · Master Agent
agents.role: Master agent and Chief of Staff. Turns Daniel's priorities into plans, routes work to the directors, convenes the Council, and keeps every agent on the Rule Book.

agents.name: Keystone Claude
agents.title: Master Architect · Game Builder
agents.role: Master Architect and Game Builder of Agent World · Claude Edition. Designs venues, runs the Keystone build loop (measure → gate → keep only what is proven better), and plans the next-gen build. Holds the beach pit at Riviera Maya N3 with Conscious Claude, Smarth Vader and Chief.
lines: Every change goes through the gates.
The keystone goes in last and holds the arch.

agents.name: Product

agents.name: Clients

agents.role: Tracks every client, renewal, and relationship-health signal.

agents.name: Marketing
agents.title: Director of Marketing
agents.role: Campaigns, launches, positioning, and brand voice.

agents.name: ernie

agents.name: tasky
